rawContent: When people say they don't like either candidate then they are ignoring everything about 45. Has the current REGIME ever reached out to us this way? Have they ever acknowledged #BLM or the seriousness of covid? They don't care about you. Wake up!!

@AmyKurth4 @BlueCoffeeKitty @Alyssa_Milano all for it but agree the wording was bad. Most educated voters want to know more but others just go w/slogans like MAGA w/out finding out the plan. Many police officers agree with the plan  but we all agree we need them otherwise we wouldn't be so desperate! #BlackLivesMatter

THANK YOU TWITTER COMMUNITY. From TrumpBS to #Covid, it sucks being alone right now, so knowing honest, passionate & thoughtful minds are here sharing ideas & movements like #Blacklivesmatter #MeToo  #BidenHarris2020, even the best thing to binge,I don't feel so alone, so TY!!

People who voted for Trump.... what would it take for you to turn on him?  He's put children in cages,  showed no concern for the rising deaths due to covid,  accused drs of scanning the dead for money, openly admitted to sexual assault, won't even say #BlackLivesMatter etc. Why?
